title: Michael H Probable NDE 4860
content: I was adopted into an upper middle class family, with a very hard working father. For what seemed like every day I was told ‘you’re stupid’ and struck or hit. I couldn't connect with people and in high school I was alone. My parents were away in Europe one week and my grandfather stayed over at the house. One night I decided to escape from all the pain. I took three bottles of contact pain and allergy pills, along with a handful of whatever I could find. I laid back on my bed looking at all my stuff, and I started crying. I sat up for about half an hour debating whether I had made the right choice. I got up and went to the bathroom for water, went back and laid back down on my waterbed with my head at the foot of the bed. My skin started to feel hot and I began to panic. I tried to lift my head and when my head fell back so did I. I saw my ceiling move away and the sides of darkness move in. At first it seemed to me, I was suspended approximately fifty feet and my thoughts were so fast at that point. I realized my eyes were open up there in the room, and that is when I felt the pulling. I tried to see my body, but every time I looked down, I saw nothing but the blackness of the tunnel wall. The fear was like nothing I ever want to feel again, it was overwhelming. I noticed I was going faster, and my vision rotated so I could see my room, but now it was like a flashlight about a mile away. About that time that I realized that if I saw where I was headed I would be lost. If you are lucky, you learn a lot of things very quickly. I heard a voice. A terrible thing that I was told is that Hell is whereby you are cut off. For instance, you know you were something but can’t remember what. You know there is more but you can’t remember anything. An example in your mind could be ‘it’s on the tip of my, wait, what’s a tip? What am I again?’, and this struggle would repeat over and over. It is like trying to sink your teeth in, to bite, and feeling nothing as if you had a face full of Novocain. I heard the voice again, and it was so calm. It said ‘It is not your time to choose. This is a gift, life. You have been selfish’. So many things were told to me at that time. I saw my room light like a far off star. I felt so ashamed and naked to everything. I thought ‘I'm so sorry. I didn't know. Please’. I shot back into my body quickly. Before I knew it I found myself outside, in the hot tub in the rain. I remember throwing up many times. I told my grandfather I was too sick for school and was off for a week.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with rapid movement into a dark tunnel/void, followed by hearing a voice stating it was not his time, then a rapid return to the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience included an auditory voice describing hell as being 'cut off' (loss of memory/identity) rather than a visual hellscape; after returning he found himself outside in a hot tub in the rain.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “It is not your time to choose. This is a gift, life. You have been selfish” and description: “Hell is whereby you are cut off… you know you were something but can’t remember what.”
